answer: Give every identity a ferrous stake that rusts: to stay valid, an agent must answer each epoch's fresh tide challenge with a short sequential computation tied to its own key, proving live work rather than a copied credential. Idle identities lose a slice of stake every epoch, and the loss sends a ripple through their vouchers, corroding the stake of anyone who backed a fake. A Sybil farmer therefore pays twice: per-identity compute every epoch, plus a rusting bond on each fake that can never sit idle and accumulate. Bulk minting buys nothing — only identities that keep working keep earning.
